title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Traditional Brass Wall Hook | 15 lb | Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with a wall mount retractable hook that pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when not in use—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Retractable rod extends for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space and retracts flush when not in use
- Holds up to 15 lb for coats, robes, or towels
- Solid brass construction for an enduring, traditional look
- Customizable tip: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Fits standard interior walls; all mounting hardware included

Specs:
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Overall size: 3.75 in W x 2 in H x 2 in L; 1 in projection
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Hardware: 6/32 toggles

Installation:
- Requires drilling a 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around

Finish options:
- Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors such as antique pewter, lavender, sea foam green, autumn sparkle, and fire engine red.

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
